title: VPC heartbeat and derivative-SLO collector for windowed token and latency signals
creator: Elena Park
description: Goal: implement a lightweight, modular heartbeat and derivative-SLO collector that runs inside customer VPC stacks (as a Terraform-managed DaemonSet or sidecar) to emit windowed aggregates for latency quantiles, client-visible error rates, saturation metrics, and token-throughput watermarks. This ticket covers the Terraform module, upgrade safety hooks, CI validation, and a playbook for interpreting alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exists at infra/modules/vpc-heartbeat and can be enabled with a single variable toggle
Collector emits 1m/5m/1h aggregates for p50/p90/p99 latency, error rate, queue/backlog length, and token-throughput per-token-type to the central telemetry cluster
Module supports zero-downtime upgrades via canaryed DaemonSet rollout and Helm/terraform hooks to validate backpressure metrics before promoting
Alerts/SLOs demonstrate expected signal fidelity in staging for synthetic and replayed traffic
Docs and runbook published in Confluence with example Grafana dashboards and remediation steps
notes: Design trade-offs: keep in-VPC collector single-threaded and low-memory (<=64MB) to avoid stealing GPU/CPU from inference workers; rely on sample-based quantile sketches for p99 to bound CPU
We decided on an exponential moving window for token throughput watermarking (default alpha=0.3) instead of fixed sliding windows to provide quicker detection of sudden spikes with graceful decay
To reduce customer IAM surface, collector uses a push model to an account-scoped telemetry ingress endpoint with short-lived mTLS certs provisioned via terraform module
We will not ship KV-cache introspection in this phase to limit surface area; follow-up ticket will add optional metric adapters for cache hit/miss if customers opt-in
implementation_plan: 1) Build Terraform module skeleton and example overlay in infra/examples/vpc-heartbeat
2) Implement collector binary in go: /repo/cmd/vpc-heartbeat with features: quantile sketching, error-class bucketing, backlog gauge, token throughput estimator
3) Add Helm chart + DaemonSet template and terraform helm_release integration with lifecycle hooks
4) Create CI pipeline job that runs a local k8s kind cluster, deploys module, runs synthetic load generator, asserts emitted aggregates to telemetry test endpoint
5) Write Confluence runbook and Grafana panels and run a staged rollout in staging private clusters
6) After staging validation, open rollout plan PR for canary to production VPCs
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Created initial terraform module skeleton and example overlay. Module exposes variables: enable, image_tag, scrape_interval_seconds, egress_endpoint. (PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/412)

2026-03-02: PoC collector binary implemented with t-digest based p90/p99 sketches and token-throughput estimator. Benchmarked at ~8ms/sample on m5.large equivalent CPU. (PR: github.com/redwood/collector/pull/89)

2026-03-04: Added helm_release resource and lifecycle pre-upgrade hook that runs a small smoke-check script validating that queue length under synthetic traffic remains below configurable watermark. Hook currently toggles 'block_upgrade' flag if threshold breached.

2026-03-05: Integration CI job green on kind. Observed that token-throughput estimator underestimates bursts when client uses very short lived tokens; noted in notes and added TODO to introduce token-class tagging in next iteration
review_feedback: PM (Amira Soto): +1 to push model for IAM reduction. Request to add clearer customer opt-out docs for telemetry ingress.
SRE (Tomás Rivera): Concern about default alert thresholds being too sensitive across small customers. Action: add sizing defaults by VPC tier (free/standard/enterprise).
Security (Priya Menon): Suggest rotating mTLS certs every 24h and document the compromise recovery flow. Added to module variables as 'cert_rotation_hours'.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Collector causing noisy alerts for short-lived spikes -> Mitigation: use EMWA and require two consecutive windows before firing paging alert
Risk: Terraform upgrades failing during heavy traffic -> Mitigation: pre-upgrade lifecycle hook runs a probability-based canary that validates ingress e2e latency before finalizing
Risk: Cost increase from exported telemetry -> Mitigation: default sampling rate 1/10 for customers on free tier and adjustable via module var
